8. Derive the uniform extended waiting incrementFor C₀>0, the actual clock bound at the current active phase gives τ_z(e_n)≥e_n/C(z). Replace C(z) by the proved C₀, then add the existing finite event time. An infinite next clock gives the extended inequality automatically. Already stopped records have ∞ on both sides, so the inequality remains valid for every n.C0>0⟹Tn+max{en/C0,0}≤Tn+1.Corresponding Lean step  have hincrement (y xRef : E) (z₀ : E × E) (e : ℕ → ℝ≥0)
      (hC : 0 < C y xRef z₀) (n : ℕ) :
      eventTime y xRef z₀ e n +
        (Real.toNNReal ((e n : ℝ) / C y xRef z₀) : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤
      eventTime y xRef z₀ e (n + 1) := by
    cases hr : record y xRef z₀ e n with
    | inr u =>
      dsimp only [eventTime]
      rw [hrecstep, hr]
      change (⊤ : WithTop ℝ≥0) + _ ≤ ⊤
